## Prologue {#sec-prologue}

**2025-08-31**

There are 17 weeks left in the year and I have

### Return to run plan

Weeks 1 to 4 are taken from [Oxford's NHS Return to Running Programme](https://www.ouh.nhs.uk/media/tinj0s3i/86729running.pdf) and then I am using runs based on Jeff Galloway's programmes and his walk/run method.

-   Week 1: Jog 1 minute then walk 1 minute for a total of 30 minutes. Repeat this every other day.
-   Week 2: Jog 2 minutes then walk 1 minute for a total of 30 minutes. Repeat this every other day.
-   Week 3: Jog 4 minutes then walk 1 minute for a total of 30 minutes. Repeat this every other day.
-   Week 4: Jog 9 minutes then walk 1 minute for a total of 30 minutes. Repeat this every other day.
-   Week 5 onwards: Twice a week 4 x 1 mile reps (40 minutes) and one long run starting at 10km (6 miles) and building to 21 km (13 miles).

### Strength plan

**Upper Body Focus (Pull-Up Progression)**

1.  Assisted Pull-ups or Negatives - 3 sets of 3-8 reps (use assistance machine or focus on slow 3-5 second lowering)
2.  Lat Pulldowns - 3 sets of 8-12 reps (wide and narrow grip variations)
3.  Seated Cable Rows - 3 sets of 10-12 reps
4.  Push-ups - 3 sets of 5-15 reps (modify on knees if needed)
5.  Dumbbell Shoulder Press - 3 sets of 8-12 reps
6.  Plank - 3 sets of 20-45 seconds
7.  Dead Hang - 3 sets of 10-30 seconds (crucial for pull-up grip strength)

**Lower Body & Core Focus**

1.  Goblet Squats - 3 sets of 10-15 reps (great for learning squat form)
2.  Romanian Deadlifts - 3 sets of 8-12 reps (targets hamstrings, supports running)
3.  Step-ups - 3 sets of 8-10 per leg
4.  Glute Bridges - 3 sets of 12-15 reps
5.  Single-leg Calf Raises - 2 sets of 10-15 per leg
6.  Side Planks - 2 sets of 15-30 seconds each side
7.  Bird Dogs - 2 sets of 8-10 per side
